She hands out the {{Badge|Forest}} to {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who defeat her. She [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Grass}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==In the core series games== Gardenia uses {{type|Grass}} Pokémon in her battles. For defeating her, Trainers receive the {{Badge|Forest}}, {{TM|86|Grass Knot}}, and the ability to use {{m|Cut}} outside of battle. Gardenia likes to explore the [[Eterna Forest]]. Unlike most Gym Leaders, challengers are required to beat all of her students to challenge her. She appears in front of the [[Old Chateau]] to warn the {{player}} of the mysterious stories of hauntings surrounding it, she hints at herself being afraid of ghosts. Later, in {{v2|Platinum}}, she will appear occasionally for rematches at the [[Battleground]]. She will also sometimes visit the [[Villa]] and will always arrive when the Houseplant is purchased. One of her lines of dialog at the Villa confirms her dislike of {{t|Ghost}}-type Pokémon and she notes that she is worried about what would happen if there was a {{2t|Grass|Ghost}} Pokémon (a type combination that had never materialized prior to [[Generation VI]]). Gardenia also appears in {{B2W2}}, taking part in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]]. She can be faced in the [[Sinnoh Leaders Tournament|Sinnoh Leaders]], [[Type Expert Tournament|Type Expert]], and [[World Leaders Tournament]]s. In {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}, Gardenia appears at the {{si|Battle Tower}}, where she can team up with [[Fantina]] in a [[Double Battle]]. ===Pokémon=== ===={{game|Diamond and Shining Pearl}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Gardenia/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Gardenia anime.png|thumb|250px|Gardenia in {{aniseries|DP}}]] ====''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl''==== Gardenia debuted in ''[[DP031|The Grass-Type Is Always Greener]]''. She was first seen unsuccessfully attempting to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Gloom}} in the [[Eterna Forest]]. She then ran off to see [[Ash's Turtwig]], which she complimented. After that, Gardenia had a short {{pkmn|battle}} with {{Ash}}, revealing to him that the [[Eterna City]] [[Gym Leader]] specialized in {{type|Grass}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, but she refrained from identifying herself as the Gym Leader. During the battle, she sent out {{p|Cherubi}} first, though she soon [[recall]]ed it. She then sent out her own {{p|Turtwig}}, which defeated both Ash's Turtwig and {{AP|Staravia}}. [[File:James and Gardenia.png|thumb|left|220px|James giving Cacnea to Gardenia]] Gardenia informed Ash, {{ashfr}}, and [[Cheryl]] that she knew about a {{p|Combee}} wall near some [[Pomeg Berry]] flowers, and she joined them during their search for the [[Amber Castle]]. The group was confronted by {{TRT}}, but instead of being horrified to learn they were thieves, Gardenia became infatuated with [[James's Carnivine]] and {{TP|James|Cacnea}} instead. She eventually decided to battle the trio after seeing [[Jessie's Seviper]], and also rescued [[Cheryl's Mothim]]. Gardenia later left the group after receiving a message from a {{p|Nuzleaf}} regarding some urgent business. Ash and his friends encountered Gardenia again at the [[Eterna Historical Museum]] in ''[[DP036|A Secret Sphere of Influence!]]''. Gardenia instantly recognized [[Nando]], who had been apprehended by [[Officer Jenny]] on suspicion of theft, from his recent Gym match victory against her. Ash and the others were surprised to learn that Gardenia was in fact the Eterna Gym Leader. Later, Gardenia and her Turtwig helped recover the stolen item in question, the [[Adamant Orb]], which had actually been stolen by Team Rocket. Gardenia had a Gym battle with Ash in ''[[DP037|The Grass Menagerie!]]''. {{AP|Turtwig}} went up against {{p|Cherubi}} first, but it was recalled. Staravia then defeated Cherubi. After Staravia was defeated by Gardenia's Turtwig's {{m|Leech Seed}}, Ash defeated it with his own Turtwig. Next, {{p|Roserade}} defeated Ash's Turtwig with its {{m|Weather Ball}}, but later, it was defeated by {{AP|Aipom}}'s {{m|Swift}} and {{m|Focus Punch}} combination, thus earning Ash the {{Badge|Forest}}. Gardenia visited [[Emeragrove Town]] to promote Pokémon battling in ''[[DP054|Once There Were Greenfields]]''. She took part in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] alongside [[James]], where they went up against Ash and {{an|Dawn}}. Gardenia's Turtwig and James's Cacnea went up against Ash's Aipom and [[Dawn's Pachirisu]]. Following Gardenia's instructions, James witnessed Cacnea as it used {{m|Drain Punch}} for the first time. Turtwig was taken out first because Gardenia was paying closer attention to Cacnea, and soon, Ash and Dawn emerged victorious. After the battle, she offered to train James's Cacnea and make it stronger, and James reluctantly accepted. She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'', where {{an|Barry}} revealed that he had earned the Forest Badge from her. ====[[Pokémon movie]]s==== Gardenia also made a cameo in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ====Character==== Gardenia is an optimist and overly cheery. Her battle style is reliant on [[harsh sunlight]], which increases the power of [[move]]s like {{m|Solar Beam}} or {{m|Weather Ball}}, and her Pokémon's incredible speed. Gardenia actively seeks out new challenges, so she often ventures to the [[Eterna Forest]] to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} new Pokémon that she could train. She is also prepared to [[trade]] for {{type|Grass}}s she feels have potential. Her obsession with Grass Pokémon is overwhelming and causes her to become flustered to such an extent that she did not take {{TRT}} seriously, due to her fascination with [[James's Carnivine]] and {{TP|James|Cacnea}}. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} =====On hand===== This listing is of Gardenia's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Gardenia |pkmn=Cherubi |type1=Grass |img=Gardenia Cherubi.png |epnum=DP031 |epname=The Grass-Type Is Always Greener! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen= |desc=Gardenia's {{p|Cherubi}} was first seen in ''[[DP031|The Grass-Type Is Always Greener!]]'' when Gardenia used it in an unofficial {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Ash's Turtwig]]. It later appeared during Ash and Gardenia's [[Gym]] battle during ''[[DP037|The Grass Menagerie!]]'', where it was able to outspeed Turtwig's attacks using its {{a|Chlorophyll}} [[Ability]] to enhance its speed and forced Ash to recall him. Nallely Solís ([[DP054]]) |es_eu=Adelaida López}} ===GOTCHA!=== Gardenia briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pocket Monsters DP=== Gardenia appeared in a flashback in [[PMDP07]]. ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Roark Gardenia Adventures.png|thumb|225px|[[Roark]] and his {{p|Cranidos}} with Gardenia and her {{p|Roserade}}]] Gardenia made her debut when she took a walk in the Eterna Forest with her Cherubi and Roserade. She was enjoying the fresh air and the scent of the forest when she recognized the scent of Gastly in the forest. Following the scent, she met the trio ({{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}}). She called out to the group, only to be ignored by them. Becoming annoyed with their attitude, she had her {{p|Roserade}} use {{m|Grass Knot}} to get their attention. She was surprised to hear that the trio had been to [[Old Chateau]] and fought the Ghost Pokémon in the place. Gardenia was supposed to investigate the place as a Gym Leader, but apparently was scared of ghosts. Revealing that she is a [[Gym Leader]], she challenged the trio to a Gym battle. Gardenia was the second [[Gym Leader]] that Platinum had battled against, and the first to have a [[Double Battle]] against. Gardenia sent out {{p|Roserade}} and {{p|Cherubi}} against [[Platinum's Empoleon|Platinum's Prinplup]] and [[Platinum's Rapidash|Ponyta]]. To avoid Ice- and Fire-type attacks, Gardenia and her Pokémon kept a great distance away from their challenger. But the distance didn't trouble them. Her {{p|Roserade}} used poisonous vines to attack, sending vines from the ground. This move easily knocked out Ponyta with a single shot. {{p|Cherubi}} on the other hand used {{m|Grass Knot}}. The attacks seemed to corner Prinplup, especially because after its Evolution, Prinplup was prone to heavier damage from Grass Knot attacks. But the battle resulted as Platinum's victory, after she used the holes in the ground (made from Roserade's vines) to her advantage by having Prinplup blow a {{m|Blizzard}} into the holes. The holes led the ice move directly to Gardenia's two Pokémon, making them unable to battle. Recognizing her defeat, Gardenia gave Platinum the Forest Badge. Gardenia would eventually join Roark, Fantina, Maylene, Crasher Wake and Candice in the battle against Team Galactic's commanders on the Spear Pillar. Gardenia and Crasher Wake faced [[Mars]] and won. After the Gym Leaders broke one of the Red Chains and were defeated by [[Cyrus]], Gardenia gave her Cherrim to Platinum. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Cherubi 2}}{{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Gardenia |gender=female |pkmn=Cherubi |type1=Grass |img=Gardenia Cherubi Adventures.png |img_size=180px |epnum=PS346 |epname=Ring Around the Roserade I |desc=Roserade and {{p|Cherubi}} were both sent against Platinum in a Double Battle. Since the opponent's chosen Pokémon could use Fire and Ice attacks, Gardenia used the wide area of her plain grass Gym to not being hit by those type of attacks. As a distance-attack technique, Roserade used her poisonous vines under the arena, who defeated Ponyta and badly injured Prinplup. After being attacked by Cherubi's {{m|Grass Knot}} (which was more powerful upon {{p|Piplup}}'s Evolution, since her weight had increased), she used her {{m|Blizzard}} in the tunnels the vines had dug, to deliver an underground at-distance attack. Cherubi's only known move is {{m|Grass Knot}}, and her Ability is {{a|Chlorophyll}}.}} {{anchor|Roserade 2}}{{TrainerPoké |main=no |trainer=Gardenia |gender=female |pkmn=Roserade |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Gardenia Roserade Adventures.png |img_size=180px |epnum=PS346 |epname=Ring Around the Roserade I |desc={{p|Roserade}} and Cherubi were both sent against Platinum in a Double Battle. Since the opponent's chosen Pokémon could use Fire and Ice attacks, Gardenia used the wide area of her plain grass Gym to not being hit by those type of attacks. As a distance-attack technique, Roserade used her poisonous vines under the arena, who defeated Ponyta and badly injured Prinplup. After being attacked by Cherubi's {{m|Grass Knot}}, Prinplup used her {{m|Blizzard}} in the tunnels the vines had dug, to deliver an underground at distance attack, who defeated both. Roserade was later seen helping in destroying one of the [[Red Chain]]s [[Cyrus]] created. Roserade's only known move is {{m|Grass Knot}}, and her Ability is {{a|Poison Point}}.}} =====Given away===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gardenia |gender=female |pkmn=Cherrim |type1=Grass |img=Platinum Cherrim.png |img_size=180px |epnum=PS413 |epname=Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia III |desc=This {{p|Cherrim}} was given to Platinum by Gardenia, and was taken with the rest of Platinum's Pokémon to help Looker investigate on the [[Distortion World]]. Cherrim's only known move is {{m|Solar Beam}}, and her Ability is {{a|Flower Gift}}.}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== [[Hareta]] first met Gardenia in [[Eterna Forest]], both mistaking the other to be part of [[Team Galactic]]. After resolving their misunderstanding and learning that Gardenia was [[Eterna City]]'s Gym Leader, Hareta asked Gardenia for a Gym battle but was promptly turned down, as Gardenia hadn't been impressed by Hareta's abilities so far. However, after being attacked by {{p|Piplup}} she changed her mind and agreed to battle. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Cherubi 3}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gardenia |pkmn=Cherubi |type1=Grass |img=Gardenia Cherubi DPA.png |epnum=DPA04 |epname=Win with Teamwork!! |desc={{p|Cherubi}} was the first Pokémon Gardenia used in the Gym battle against Hareta. It went up against his {{TP|Hareta|Shinx}} and was able to put up a great fight as it was finished off with {{p|Shinx}}'s {{m|Bite}}. It was revealed that Cherubi used Leech Seed as part of the laid-out traps when [[Hareta's Piplup]] got to battle. Cherubi's only known move is {{m|Leech Seed}}.}} {{anchor|Turtwig 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gardenia |pkmn=Turtwig |type1=Grass |img=Gardenia Turtwig DPA.png |epnum=DPA04 |epname=Win with Teamwork!! |desc={{p|Turtwig}} was the second Pokémon used in the Gym battle. It went up against Hareta's Shinx and allowed itself to get defeated by Shinx's {{m|Spark}}. Turtwig's only known move is {{m|Grass Knot}}.}} {{anchor|Roserade 3}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gardenia |pkmn=Roserade |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Gardenia Roserade DPA.png |epnum=DPA04 |epname=Win with Teamwork!! |desc={{p|Roserade}} is Gardenia's strongest Pokémon. It was the third Pokémon used in the Gym battle. It managed to defeat Hareta's Shinx due to the trap that her Turtwig set up. It also battled with {{p|Misdreavus}} where Misdreavus used {{m|Spite}} to lower the PP of Magical Leaf. Misdreavus too got defeated by Roserade which left {{TP|Hareta|Piplup}} as the last Pokémon. After narrowly dodging Roserade's attacks, Piplup won the battle with an airborne {{m|Peck}} as Roserade could no longer use Magical Leaf to protect itself.
